_comment: Flat-path run-deadline mapping: request -> the RawResponsePayload the relay submits for a sub-request the run budget left unissued. One stub PER abandoned request, each carrying its own real URL, so the App Server can name the individual missing segments and re-plan exactly those. Reference: deadlineStubResponse in frontend/src/lib/refresh/orchestrator.ts. Ports: _synthetic_deadline (CLI orchestrator.py), BrokerClient.syntheticDeadline (macOS). AUTHORED input, GENERATED expect - run `make gen-vectors` after changing the reference.

vectors.name: a per-day fan-out request keeps its own day
a sibling day maps to a distinct stub, never the first request's
a path-only url with a per-segment purpose survives verbatim
